fields.name: statusCode
fields.description: Transaction status code. `0`: Pending, `1`: Cleared, `2`: Declined

fields.name: limit
fields.description: Number of items per page. Default: `100`. Range: [`1`, `500`]

fields.name: page
fields.description: Page number. Default: `1`. Min: `1

fields.name: pan4
fields.description: Last 2/4 digits of card number, used to filter transactions of a specific card

fields.description: Start time of transaction (Unix ms timestamp)

fields.name: createEndTime
fields.description: End time of transaction (Unix ms timestamp)

fields.name: merchName

fields.name: type
fields.description: Query type.`SIDE_QUERY_AUTH`: Authorization`SIDE_QUERY_FINANCIAL`: Clearing. Requires `txnId` and `orderNo`.`SIDE_QUERY_REFUND`: Refund. Requires `txnId` and `orderNo`.The following query types are available to all users:`SIDE_QUERY_AUTH_ALL`: All authorization transactions`SIDE_QUERY_AUTH_REVERSAL`: Authorization reversals`SIDE_QUERY_FINANCIAL_ALL`: All clearing transactions`SIDE_QUERY_FINANCIAL_REFUND`: Clearing refunds

fields.name: txnId

fields.name: orderNo
fields.description: Order number. Exact match

fields.name: itemType
fields.description: Item type. `1`: Virtual item, `2`: Physical item

fields.name: itemBizType

fields.name: orderBy
